basic_profile.bio: A 37-year-old history enthusiast and strategy game aficionado from Liverpool, UK. I work as a software developer during the day, but my evenings are dedicated to playing Mount & Blade and exploring medieval history. As a single guy, I enjoy the freedom to dive deep into my hobbies and spend a fair bit of time on Reddit. I'm usually online from 6 PM to midnight UK time. I have a keen interest in game modding, and I occasionally dabble in creating my own mods for Bannerlord. While I appreciate a well-structured debate, I have little patience for toxicity and drama.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My love for history and strategy games led me to extensively research medieval warfare and politics, which I often share in the form of detailed posts on subreddits like Bannerlord. My modding skills are self-taught, honed through countless hours of experimenting with game files and learning from the modding community.
